product_name: Fujifilm X-T50 40 MP APS-C X-Trans Sensor | Retro Style Mirrorless Camera | 4K/6.2K Vlogging | High Speed Recording FHD 240fps | Advance AF with 16-50mm Optical Zoom Lens f/2.8-4.8 - Silver
model_name: F X-T50 S 16-50mm KIT WW2 CD
description: The Fujifilm X-T50 is a compact retro-style mirrorless camera combining a 40.2 MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS 5 HR sensor, X-Processor 5, advanced autofocus, 7-stop in-body image stabilization, Fujifilm Film Simulation modes, and high-resolution video recording. This variant includes the XF 16-50mm F2.8-4.8 R LM WR lens.
about_this_item: FUJIFILM X-T50 inherits the X-T Series design with a close resemblance to a classic film camera. The compact body weighs approximately 438g (0.96lb), with sleek and ergonomic styling.
Features an all-new Film Simulation dial on the top plate with access to 20 Film Simulation modes, including REALA ACE.
Features shutter speed, exposure compensation and Film Simulation dials on the top plate, allowing settings to be adjusted without turning the camera on.
Features a 2.36-million-dot electronic viewfinder with 0.62x magnification, high-definition live view and adjustable diopter control.
Features a tilting LCD display for enhanced versatility, including waist-level shooting.

camera.display: 3-inch tilting touchscreen LCD, approximately 1.84 million dots

key_features: 40.2 MP APS-C X-Trans CMOS 5 HR sensor
